title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a name a disabled package holds through a stored row is judged over the served set, never by save order (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu1G7fkwF83ym3AWRxuxcWf1)_

Part of #32354

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — on both transports, `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME?package=D` (D disabled, holding the name only as a stored row, an enabled package shipping it in code) answers the withheld 404 where it served D's row under the shipping package's envelope; a bare read of a name held by stored rows of two or more enabled packages and of a disabled one is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming only the enabled holders. Three bare reads widen from 404 or 409 to 200 with the one enabled holder's row (table below).
Metadata-protocol: none — no key, value or metadata type an author writes changes; what moves is which stored row a by-name read answers while a package is disabled.
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc teaches the by-name answer for a name a disabled package holds through a stored row; `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` already says a disabled module is hidden.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 不指名包读取一个元数据名时，如果这个名字只由存储行持有、其中某个包已停用，现在按「在用的持有者」判定：只剩一个在用包就答它的行，两个以上就 409 且只点名在用包；不再按保存顺序答 404，也不再在 409 里点名停用包。`?package=停用包` 对只以存储行持有该名的停用包答 404。
- **为什么改：** 专题 ADR-0150 D3：停用一个包，它在每个读门上都应消失，而且结果不随保存顺序变化。
- **风险与回滚：** 第一方 0 处（没有第一方应用在启动时停用包）。收窄两处：`?package=停用包` 200 → 404；三个包的存储行同名且其一停用时，裸读 → 409。回滚即 revert 本 PR。本 PR 叠在 #32501 的 PR 之上，必须在它之后落地。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` 的 `servedRowHolderOf` 与 `servedAddressOf`；`protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` 的两处调用；`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` 的 `disabledExactAddressHolder` 新增一行。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`，预期 16 例全过（`main` 上本卡 12 例中 10 例红，余 2 例是对照）。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

Branch head `cd1143c19`. Its diff against `main` 2f80f2897 is 15 files, +883 / −33: this card's 7 files plus the 9 of #32501 (`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` carries both), because this branch merged #32501's head. **This PR stacks on #32501's PR (#32808) and lands after it**; once that one lands and `main` is merged here, the diff is this card's 7 files, +436 / −11.

**The fix** (three hunks in `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, unchanged since the card's development round):

1. **Rows judged over the served set** (`protocol-meta-item-face.ts`: `servedRowHolderOf`, `servedAddressOf`). A read naming no package, of a name a disabled package holds, takes the registry's served holder as before (#32183), else the stored rows' one served holder: the registry's served holders together with the packages the active rows are bound to, less every disabled package. One → read at its address; two or more → the by-name read's own refusal (`ambiguous-in-environment`) naming only those (seat ruling 6817756360 Q2); none → the read as before. Asked only while some installed package is disabled, of a type the registry reads by package, when no enabled package ships the name in code and no package-less row or environment item is stored. The plain read (`readMetaItemFace`) and both layered sites (`packagelessLayeredReadRefusal`, `getMetaItemLayered`) call it.
2. **A disabled package's own address** (`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` `disabledExactAddressHolder`, one line): an address naming a disabled package is its withheld item whether it holds the name in the registry or only as a stored row.
3. The two `/published` doors were re-measured and not touched: they serve the enabled row through the plain read.

**Moved answers.** FROM measured on `main` 2f80f2897 and on `main` + #32501 (`1d8ea4ad7`, this branch with this card's four source files put back); TO on this head. D disabled, E (and F) enabled. Both transports; both registration orders; the save orders as listed.

| # | state | door | FROM `main` | FROM `main` + #32501 | TO this head | arm |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| C1a | rows of E and D only, no shipper, D's row saved first | bare plain read, `/layers`, `/published` | 404 (plain read; the others †) | the same | 200, E's row | widening |
| C1b | the same, E's row saved first | bare `/layers` | 409 naming E and D | the same | 200, E's layers | widening |
| C1b′ | the same | bare plain read | 200, E's row | the same | the same | none |
| C1c | D ships the name in code, E holds it only as a row | bare plain read, `/layers`, `/published` | 404 (plain read; the others †) | the same | 200, E's row | widening |
| C3 | E ships the name in code, D holds it only as a row | `?package=D` | 200, D's row under E's `_packageId` | 404 (already: #32501's strict envelope) | 404 | narrowing (see note) |
| Q2 | rows of D, E, F, no shipper, D saved first | bare plain read | 404 | the same | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming E and F, `details.candidates` | refusal moved |
| Q2′ | the same | bare `/layers` | 409 naming D, E and F † | † | 409 naming E and F | same status, D unnamed |
| C2 | the environment's package-less row beside E and D both shipping | bare `/layers` code layer | E's | E's | E's | none (CONTROL) |

† Not reached on that leg: a pin stops at its first failing assertion, so the cell is the card's development-round reading, the one the changeset declares (measured then on the #32183 head `6655b742`).

Every case re-enabled: the answers go back (C1a/C1b pins re-enable D and see `/layers` refuse naming both). The changeset also lists the other save order of Q2 (200 with the first-saved enabled row → 409) from the card's development round; these pins save D first and did not re-measure it.

**Note on C3.** On `main` + #32501 the 404 is already there: #32501's strict envelope (its F1) leaves D's row its own stamp, which the item face withholds. This card's hunk 2 is a second guard for the same answer. Measured (table below): hunk 2 off → C3 green; #32501's F1 off → C3 green; both off → C3 red. The changeset still declares C3, which #32501's changeset does not.

## Merge

- `cd1143c19` merges #32501's head `1d8ea4ad7`, which already carries `main` 2f80f2897 and #32497's landed head `28b37fbb7` as merges, so `git merge origin/main` afterwards was `Already up to date`. Merging `origin/main` first was measured with `git merge-tree` and conflicted in 14 files (#32497 landed squashed); through #32501's head, one conflict.
- `git show --remerge-diff cd1143c19` touches one file, `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`: the `getMetaItemLayered` host `Pick` list, where #32497 added `'getServicesRegistry'` and this card added `'packagelessAddress'` and `'shippedArtifactsOf'`; the resolution keeps all three.
- The F3 call (`exactQualifierItem` at the `/layers` code layer) is `main`'s; this card does not touch it.

## Acceptance notes

- **`Part of`, not `Fixes`.** Epic note 6820147040 carried list cases here (a disabled sole holder's pair member row and a dependent's added locale listed by the unscoped list; the list scoped to a disabled base lists its pair's member row), and #32670 says this card owns them. No list door is touched here, so merging should not close the card. If the seat rules those cases belong to another card, the seat turns the first line into the closing form.
- **Case 2 (the environment's own item beside an enabled and a disabled shipper):** the premise is unreachable (`overlaySlotBinding` answers the environment's item only when no package ships the name); one CONTROL pin per registration order (seat ruling 6817756360 Q3).
- **Not here:** the save door (#32605); two enabled packages' stored rows of a name nobody ships with no package disabled (#32607, which carries a copy of this patch and merges this branch after it lands).
- **Branch name:** `claude/project-thread-pv4nip` is the card thread's harness-pinned branch (claim 6817604765), not `claude/issue-32354-…`.
- A comment in the runtime pin file repeats `(#32622).` twice; left as is.
